name: Camus Pfalzgraf von Silvaner Luneburg
original_name: カミユ・パァルツグラーフ・フォン・ジルヴァーナー・リューネブルク
source:
Star Sign: Virgo
Hobby: Flower Language
Special Skill: Precognition
Club: Gardening
Likes: Flowers (Especially Red Roses the color of his eyes), Nature
Dislikes: Places with lots of people, Sports
Image Color: Yellow

The youngest son of a count. He loves flowers.
He's weak but has a mysterious power to predict the future so he was raised without leaving his mansion.
He's a distant relative of [url=/c45331]Ludwig[/url].
